# Spinelli Real Estate

> Independent, family-owned boutique real estate agency serving Shellharbour, Wollongong, Kiama and the wider Illawarra and NSW South Coast.

Spinelli Real Estate provides residential property sales, property management, commercial sales and leasing, prestige property sales, development site sales, off-the-plan project marketing, free property appraisals, auction services and property investment guidance across the Illawarra region of New South Wales, Australia.

## About

Spinelli Real Estate is an independent, family-owned boutique agency with deep local knowledge and a commitment to premium service. The agency is led by Paul Spinelli and Adam Spinelli, both experienced and well-regarded Illawarra property professionals.

The agency differentiates itself from franchise competitors through personalised service, strong local connections, and a focus on achieving the best outcome for each individual client.

## Key Personnel

- **Paul Spinelli** — Principal / Director. Experienced residential and commercial sales professional serving the Illawarra.
- **Adam Spinelli** — Director. Specialises in residential sales, project marketing and prestige property across Shellharbour and Wollongong.
